entry.title: nivomoney: A neobank, opened up to be read
entry.summary: A neobank, opened up to be read. Nine Go services. A double-entry ledger. React on the front. It ran live. Now it is a record: what was built, and how.

entry.title: ledgerq: A durable queue that lives on one disk
entry.summary: A durable queue that lives on one disk. Messages go to an append-only log and survive a crash. No network. No cluster. Nothing beyond Go's standard library.
